title: The hotel WiFi
drDigitalIntro:
The laptop is offline in a café and the network needs joining.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

playgroundTask.goal: You got online on a public network and turned off tracking

steps.say: Click the WiFi icon in the menu bar.
The sign-in page appeared — continue past it.
Open Settings from the dock and find Privacy.
Turn off cross-site tracking now that you are on a network you do not control.

drDigitalSuccess: Online, and with tracking turned off on a network you do not control. That is the right order to do it in.
drDigitalHint: The WiFi icon is in the bar across the top. Public networks usually show a sign-in page before they let you through.
